label: Photography genre
description: Photographic genres and recognizable shooting conventions, from studio portraits to surveillance images.
notes: Genres and recognizable photographic uses belong here, including commercial work, records and informal snapshots. camera.composition owns spatial arrangement, camera.color_grade owns palette and tonal finishing, and camera.film_look owns grain and photographic surface texture. Values name a genre or a familiar type of photograph after “in the style of”; their look describes characteristic framing and light rather than a required subject. Period-inspired genres remain available for contemporary scenes.

values.look: Candid street moments framed among passersby, signs and buildings, often in available light.
Expressive clothing poses, styled sets or locations, and dramatic light arranged like a magazine fashion story.
A single object dominates a controlled setup, with shaped highlights, clean surfaces and carefully managed reflections.
Dishes are styled close to the camera, with side light revealing texture, gloss and steam.
Formal clothing, intimate couple portraits and candid ceremony moments, with soft light and polished skin tones.
Dark skies reveal dense stars, a bright Milky Way or colored nebulae through long exposures.
Athletes are caught at peak motion in tight frames, with crisp action and distant backgrounds.
Carefully aligned building edges, straight verticals and deliberate light emphasize structure and materials.
Wide corner views show entire furnished rooms, with bright interiors, readable windows and straight verticals.
A hurried, obstructed or tightly zoomed view catches someone unposed, often with harsh flash and rough framing.
A decisive public moment is shown with surrounding context, available light and direct, unpolished detail.
Unposed everyday activity unfolds in contextual frames, with natural light and visible details of lived surroundings.
A deliberately posed sitter stands against a controlled backdrop, with shaped studio light and tidy framing.
A seated half-length pose, even flash and a mottled or laser-pattern backdrop create a school photo studio look.
A front-facing head is centered against a blank pale background, with flat light and a neutral expression.
A stark front-and-profile identification layout uses flat flash, a plain wall and sometimes height marks.
A tightly cropped head-and-shoulders portrait uses a turned pose, neat clothing and a subdued studio background.
An informal group bunches together in familiar surroundings, with casual cropping and household light or direct flash.
Landmarks and local activity share broad, inviting frames, with vivid daylight and a strong sense of place.
Animals are observed in their habitat, often isolated by a long lens against soft natural backgrounds.
Tiny insects, petals or droplets fill the frame, revealing minute textures against a very soft background.
A high oblique viewpoint reveals terrain, rooftops and roads as broad shapes with visible depth.
Submerged subjects appear through blue-green water, with drifting particles, softened distance and rippled light.
Performers fill the frame amid colored stage beams, dark crowds, glowing haze and strong light-dark contrast.
An unclothed figure is posed as sculptural form, with deliberate cropping and light tracing the body.
Intimate reclining poses, lingerie and bedroom settings use soft window light and close, flattering framing.
Sensual poses, glossy skin and sculpted curves are emphasized by polished studio light and retouching.
Full outfits are shown on posed models in consistent, simple locations, with readable silhouettes and even light.
Merchandise is shown in plain, repeatable views against a seamless background, with even light and clear edges.
Staged, broadly legible activities use bright even light, tidy surroundings and space for advertising copy.
A casually posed subject inhabits a curated everyday setting, with flattering window light and coordinated props.
Objects are arranged on one surface and photographed straight down, with soft shadows and deliberate spacing.
Inanimate objects form a deliberate tabletop arrangement, with side light shaping volume and cast shadows.
Wide, matter-of-fact room or location views show evidence markers and spatial relationships under direct light.
Evidence fills a square-on close view beside a measuring scale, with flat light and sharply readable surface detail.
A body area is recorded in a direct, standardized close view with neutral color, even light and a plain background.
Cells, crystals or tissue fill a microscope field, with flattened depth and stained or translucent colors.
A fixed high corner view surveys a wide area, with coarse detail, flat contrast and impersonal framing.
A straight-down orbital view flattens land, clouds and cities into large maplike patterns.
Close partygoers are hit by direct flash, with dark surroundings, soft instant-film color and a white print border.
A head-and-shoulders pose, teased hair, soft-focus glow and a colored studio backdrop evoke a mall portrait package.
Uniformed players line up in seated and standing rows, facing the camera in even daylight or broad flash.
A posed person shares the frame with their workplace or home, with contextual objects and available light.
A neatly posed head-and-shoulders view uses restrained clothing, a simple background and smooth, even face lighting.
An extremely close face crop emphasizes makeup, skin and lips with crisp catchlights and carefully sculpted light.
Broad landforms fill a deep, detailed view, with weather and directional light defining distance.
Surf, rocks and a broad horizon anchor the frame, often with long-exposure water and soft coastal light.
A towering storm front or lightning dominates a wide sky above a small, dark strip of land.
Machinery and factory structures fill precise, detailed frames under hard work lights or dramatic industrial glow.
Tight crops turn reflections, textures or shadows into shapes and colors whose original subject is hard to identify.
